visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Changes Go to a Copy
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every element should double and print 2 4 6, but the array prints 1 2 3 unchanged.

solution.explanation: The array parameter is a pointer, so writing to a[i] changes the caller's data. Doubling a local copy never touches the array, so nothing visible changes. Assign the result back into a[i].
